title: R1/R2 lettered and numeric-suffix variants (R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, R2X) - pitched-roof envelope inherited via ZR 11-25 suffix inheritance (OWNER DECISION D-049, 2026-09-13)
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the pitched-roof envelope HEIGHT constraints for R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, and R2X. NONE of these five district symbols is named in ZR 23-421's opening enumeration ('R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A' - only the BARE group labels 'R1' and 'R2' appear). This rule instead applies ZR 11-25's general suffix-inheritance principle ('All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution') to extend the SAME 25 ft perimeter-wall / 35 ft ridge envelope (both above the base plane) that 23-421 expressly states for bare 'R1'/'R2' to these five suffixed variants. THIS IS AN OWNER DECISION (D-049, 2026-09-13; source: project-control/directives/D-049-encode-11-25-reading), NOT a qualified legal sign-off and NOT G6 clearance - every value this rule emits carries an explicit owner-decision provenance marker and is DRAFT/needs-review until a qualified zoning professional confirms at G6 that 11-25's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions' caveat is fully accounted for (the professional-confirmation ask remains OPEN at docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md, section A1). This is deliberately NEVER presented as an express per-variant citation of 23-421 (that enumeration does not name any of these five symbols). R2X carries its own ZR 23-21 floor-area-ratio row (1.00, grouped with R4) distinct from R2/R2A (0.75); per the owner's D-049-R002 reading this is a FLOOR-AREA-ONLY express exception that does NOT modify the height envelope computed here - surfaced as a documented limitation with its own citation, never silently assumed either way. FAIL-CLOSED INPUT: applicability is conditional on BUILDING TYPE, exactly as the bare-label rule. The section 23-421(g) 5-ft reference-plane allowance does NOT apply to any of these five lettered-suffix variants (only to no-letter-suffix R1-1, R1-2, and bare R2 - encoded in the separate r1-r2-reference-plane-23421g rule, which excludes these five). NOT a Verified determination.

citations.quote: All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution.

R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A ... Perimeter walls are subject to setback regulations at a maximum height above the base plane of 25 feet. ... These planes ... meet at a ridge line of 35 feet above the base plane.

MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA RATIO FOR R1-R5 DISTRICTS. R2X | Standard zoning lots 1.00 | Qualifying residential sites 1.00 (R2X occupies its own 23-21 row at standard FAR 1.00, distinct from the R2/R2A row at 0.75 and from the R4 row).

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Applicability is EXACTLY the five suffixed symbols this rule inherits the envelope for via ZR 11-25 (in_set); bare 'R1'/'R2' (express rule, r1-r2-bare-pitched-height) and every other district are NOT matched here (visible not_applicable).

inputs.name: building_type
inputs.description: Building type. REQUIRED and FAIL-CLOSED: no canonical property_profile field exposes building type, so in practice this is unavailable and the evaluation returns professional_review_required with no value. The inherited pitched-roof envelope applies only to the source-named single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line forms; 'attached'/'other' yield a visible not_applicable (none of these five variants appears in section 23-422's flat-roof list either).

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.commercial_overlays[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.special_districts[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44; e.g. section 119-212 Special Hillsides Preservation District Tier II, section 113-523 Special Ocean Parkway subdistrict).

inputs.name: historic_district
inputs.description: True iff the lot is in a designated LPC Historic District (section 23-426(a)); when true -> professional_review_required.

inputs.name: large_site
inputs.description: True iff a large-site context (section 23-425) applies; when true -> professional_review_required.

inputs.name: transportation_infrastructure_adjacent
inputs.description: True iff the lot's frontage is adjacent to the described transportation infrastructure (section 23-443(b), +10 ft in R1-R6 for multiple dwellings); when true -> professional_review_required.

outputs.name: max_perimeter_wall_height
outputs.description: Maximum perimeter-wall height (ft) ABOVE THE BASE PLANE, inherited from section 23-421 via ZR 11-25 suffix inheritance (OWNER DECISION D-049). Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result.

outputs.name: max_building_height
outputs.description: Maximum ridge/building height (ft) ABOVE THE BASE PLANE, inherited from section 23-421 via ZR 11-25 suffix inheritance (OWNER DECISION D-049). Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result.

parameters.name: perimeter_wall_height_ft
parameters.note: Maximum perimeter-wall height 25 ft above the base plane, the SAME numeric value section 23-421 states expressly for bare 'R1'/'R2', extended to these five suffixed variants via ZR 11-25 (OWNER DECISION D-049, 2026-09-13). Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

parameters.name: ridge_height_ft
parameters.note: Maximum ridge/building height 35 ft above the base plane, the SAME numeric value section 23-421 states expressly for bare 'R1'/'R2', extended to these five suffixed variants via ZR 11-25 (OWNER DECISION D-049, 2026-09-13). Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

steps.note: Maximum perimeter-wall height above the base plane, inherited via ZR 11-25 (owner decision).
Maximum ridge/building height above the base plane, inherited via ZR 11-25 (owner decision).

exceptions.description: This rule's applicability to R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, and R2X rests on an OWNER-DECISION reading of ZR 11-25's suffix-inheritance principle (D-049, 2026-09-13), NOT an express per-variant citation of section 23-421 (which names only bare 'R1'/'R2'). The professional-confirmation ask (whether 11-25's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions' caveat is fully accounted for) remains OPEN at docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md section A1 pending G6.

R2X sits in its own ZR 23-21 floor-area-ratio table row (standard 1.00, grouped with R4/R4-1/R4A/R4B) distinct from the R2/R2A row (0.75). Per the owner's D-049-R002 reading, this FAR difference is a floor-area-only express exception under section 23-21; it does NOT modify the height/setback envelope computed by this rule, which R2X shares with R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, and R2A. Surfaced as a documented limitation so the FAR distinction is never silently read as also changing height.

The setback above the perimeter wall is governed by the sloping-plane / pitched-roof geometry of section 23-421 paragraphs (a)-(f), NOT a flat numeric depth. It is not reduced to a single number here (A2 gap, D-045-R008) and requires professional review.
A commercial overlay may modify residence-district height (section 23-44); the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

A mapped special district may modify height (section 23-44; e.g. section 119-212 Special Hillsides Preservation District Tier II, section 113-523 Special Ocean Parkway subdistrict); the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
In a designated LPC Historic District the perimeter-wall height may be required to match adjacent buildings (section 23-426(a)); the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
A large-site context (section 23-425) may govern; the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

A transportation-infrastructure-adjacent frontage (section 23-443(b)) permits a +10 ft maximum-height increase in R1-R6 for the described multiple dwellings; the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict).

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.

OWNER DECISION, NOT a qualified legal sign-off: this rule's district coverage rests on the owner's D-049 (2026-09-13) reading of ZR 11-25's suffix-inheritance principle applied to section 23-421's bare 'R1'/'R2' labels, never presented as an express per-variant citation. The professional confirmation of this application remains open (docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md section A1).
R2X's distinct section 23-21 FAR row (1.00) is a floor-area-only exception and does not modify the height envelope encoded here (D-049-R002).

The section 23-421(g) 5-ft reference-plane allowance does NOT apply to any of these five lettered-suffix variants; it is scoped, in the separate r1-r2-reference-plane-23421g rule, to no-letter-suffix R1-1, R1-2, and bare R2 only.
Heights are measured ABOVE THE BASE PLANE, not above curb; the base-plane determination is a separate professional input.
Applicability requires a building type that has no canonical property_profile field; without it the rule fails closed to professional_review_required.
The setback is pitched-plane geometry (23-421 paragraphs a-f), not a flat depth; surfaced as a documented limitation / professional review (A2 gap, D-045-R008), not a numeric setback constraint.

The section 23-424 qualifying-residential-site alternative envelope (35 ft base / 35 ft building height) is a SEPARATE rule (r1-r2-qrs-height) and competes with this rule's output when both are simultaneously applicable (same-family conflict, never a silent precedence pick).

The pitched envelope is a permitted alternative building form, never rendered as a pitched-roof REQUIREMENT; section 23-413(a) governs rooftop obstructions for any envelope shape and is not modeled here.
